newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street Deli names Henderson president.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street Deli names Henderson president.

text.p: Wall Street Deli Inc said on Tuesday that it named Louis Henderson Jr to president and chief executive.
Wall Street Deli also appointed Robert Barrow, the company's former president and CEO, to the newly created position of vice chairman of the board.
Prior to joining Wall Street Deli, Louis Henderson served as president of The Hackney Group, a privately-held business management company.
Wall Street Deli said it plans to enter the franchising business with its suburban the company's concept co-branded with a TCBY franchise.
Wall Street Deli owns and operates a chain of 117 delicatessen-style sandwich shops in 17 cities.
